analysis.overall: You had a solid day overall with 85% time in range and a remarkably stable overnight period, though post-meal timing caused a mild low in the evening and delayed spikes after larger meals.

events.title: Post-lunch stubborn peak
events.description: Carbs from your 50g lunch outpaced your insulin, bringing you up to 195 mg/dL and keeping you lingering in the 180s for a few hours despite small correction boluses.

events.title: Evening low dip
events.description: Active insulin from your late afternoon bolus pulled your glucose down to a low of 56 mg/dL before gently recovering back into range.

events.title: Smooth overnight stability
events.description: Your basal rates held remarkably flat through the early morning, keeping you resting comfortably around 90-100 mg/dL straight until wake-up.

events.title: Breakfast delayed rise
events.description: A pre-bolus for 68g of carbs initially pulled your glucose down to 76 mg/dL before the food digested, resulting in a late morning climb up to 185 mg/dL.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Watch out for meal pre-bolus timing on bigger carb meals, as insulin seems to hit early before carb absorption fully kicks in.
